sources.title: Monarchie de Juillet

sources.title: Février1848 — Révolution de février

sources.title: Février1848 — Gouvernement provisoire et proclamation de la Deuxième République
sources.usage: Read historical body lines137–156: provisional government initially declares intention for republic and legislates by decree pending electoral/constituent legitimation; direct male suffrage decree5March and formal juridical proclamation4May1848. sources.title: La Constitution du4novembre1848 — reproduced primary text
sources.usage: Read primary constitutional body preamble, articles18–25,43–48,51,64,67–68 and112–116 plus historical introduction. Supports unicameral legislature, executive president, ministerial appointment/dismissal and prohibition of presidential dissolution; December implementation checked separately. Colonial article109 does not establish indigenous consent or identical territorial implementation.

sources.title: Décembre1848–mai1849 — Élection présidentielle et victoire de Louis-Napoléon Bonaparte

absenceOfEvidence: May–December detailed executive changes (Executive Commission and Cavaignac), ministries and transition hours are not proposed as government facts.
